summary: Moz2D expanded color-format support and heavy SIMD work to speed image operations: CMYK (and inverted CMYK) were added as surface formats, and swizzling/convolution routines gained NEON/SSE/SSSE3/AVX2-specialized implementations. The patchset also adds safety checks for transferable image buffers and falls back to scalar code where needed, improving both correctness and performance for image processing on many CPUs.
